2760-3845-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-3845-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-3845-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

728-4775-6553.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

394-856-4247-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

560-4050-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-4050-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

2173-3944-5220-6772.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1329-1477-1494-4840.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Cast Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Extruder five times by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2921-4556-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2921-4556-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

632-3621-4659-5129-7297.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-5129-7297.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2034-2452-5795-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {0}.
Repeat.

985-3713-5078-5268.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

4063-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
4063-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

967-1308-3809-3967-7087.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

323-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
323-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2457-3000-4289-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3490-4659-6638.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4659-6638.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Tidus triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

803-1789-2921-5649.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
803-1789-2921-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

719-4231-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

222-527-4068-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-4068-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2558-4659-5123-5687.notablePrerequisites: You control no more than two additional creatures.
2558-4659-5123-5687.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Jetmir, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1636-2527-3143-4050.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-3143-4050.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1636-2692-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-2692-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

851-4770-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
851-4770-5554.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

654-1018-1541-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skullwinder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Skullwinder from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Skullwinder and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Skullwinder triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand, and causing an opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1516-3179-3860-4050.description:
Cast Devoted Grafkeeper from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {W}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as Departed Soulkeeper.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Warrior and Departed Soulkeeper, adding {W}{U}.
Departed Soulkeeper is not exiled due to Overwhelming Splendor removing its ability.
Repeat.

2499-4813-5003-5256.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
2499-4813-5003-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Famished Foragers' power.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.

751-3314-3470-3478.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

974-2816-3984-4417.manaNeeded: {1}{B/P}, plus an additional {4}{B/P} available if you do not control a Smaug token
974-2816-3984-4417.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Umbral Mantle attached to Satsuki.
Satsuki does not have summoning sickness.
974-2816-3984-4417.description:
Activate Satsuki by tapping it, putting a lore counter on There and Back Again.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing a lore counter from There and Back Again and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the There and Back Again ability, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token.
If you control two Smaugs, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If you do, the Smaug that died triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
If you made Treasures this way, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Activate Satsuki by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

369-2034-2730.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Repeat.

358-1368-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stitcher's Supplier, adding {B}.
Stitcher's Supplier dies, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Stitcher's Supplier for its escape cost by paying {B} and exling three other cards from your graveyard.
Stitcher's Supplier enters the battlefield, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1020-2478-3698-4986.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping itself.
Repeat.

391-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-3756-4222.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
